beats: slot 1 shows where the money goes today — the income, the accounts and the bills it flows through, with real dollar amounts
slot 2 names the leak — the one flow that quietly drains the account, its monthly $ cost and why nobody notices it
slot 3 flips the order — the rule that reroutes the money, step by step, each step a flow the viewer could draw
slot 4 is the payoff — the same money after 1, 5 and 10 years, compared side by side in plain numbers
title_patterns: money-flow explainer ("Where Your Paycheck Actually Goes — Explained")
one-rule rewire ("Pay Yourself First: The Order That Builds Wealth")
side-by-side outcome ("Same $4,000 Salary, Two Very Different Lives")
story_structure.payoff_rule: the closing lands one before/after comparison in plain numbers plus the single rule to keep — a mic-drop, never a summary
story_structure.format_description: One persistent diagram per chapter that the narration moves word by word: income, accounts and bills as boxes, money as flows, numbers as live counters. Brand name and colours come from each channel's own kit.

variation_rules: distinct money flow per video — the habit or account mechanism differs from every case in the channel's last 5 videos (enforced: the variation gate similarity + seed rotation)
no recycled example set — different dollar scenarios against the last 5 videos (enforced: the variation gate similarity)
no repeated hook across the channel's last 5 videos (enforced: the variation gate similarity)
every figure is concrete and checkable (a stated salary, rate or period) — prose for the author and the review desk
